defects_found_none_in_scope.F-1: Binance REMOVED cumBase/cumQuote/avgPrice from POST /papi/v1/um/order effective 2026-07-14 (official changelog, verified). _decimal_str(None) silently returns '0', so fill amounts and average prices are wrong for every fill. External contract drift, not a defect of this stage's five items.
defects_found_none_in_scope.F-2: Binance uses positive error codes on margin endpoints and negative on UM/CM; domain.py's code tables are all negative literals, so the ENTIRE margin product line is unmatched and falls through to the non-fatal counter default. Previous stage's classification design.
defects_found_none_in_scope.F-3: _business_msg() extracts Binance's error message but hedge_open_leg has no column for it and hedge_open_log records only request params — the exchange's own words are discarded.
defects_found_none_in_scope.F-4: 51169 (MARGIN_TRADE_COEFF_INSUFFICIENT) root cause undetermined. Ruled out: NOMUSDT not margin-tradable (falsified by public exchangeInfo). Ruled out as a remedy: a PAPI test-order endpoint (does not exist; official docs checked). Unproven: concurrency contention.

live_acceptance_findings.outstanding_real_position: The perp leg filled: SHORT 10000 NOMUSDT, orderId 888412130, unhedged, residual -10000. review_1_miss.why_it_differed: Grok measured it against 10-design §2.5, whose wording makes the grid checks read as optional. review_1_miss.significance: This is the first real miss by the Grok review-1 channel, which the user enabled for this stage (15-user-authorized-grok-review-1.md).
